prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of an old-fashioned, boxy CRT television dominates the frame, its curved glass screen displaying a mesmerizing pattern of colorful static—diagonal lines of red, green, and blue pixels shimmering in a hypnotic, analog distortion. The television is angled slightly to the right, filling most of the composition and emphasizing the texture of the pixel grid and the subtle curvature of the screen. The background is softly out of focus, hinting at a sunlit interior with pale walls and a window that lets in diffused natural light, creating a gentle contrast between the cool, artificial glow of the TV and the warm, ambient daylight. The overall color palette is muted and nostalgic, with subdued earth tones and soft highlights, evoking a retro, cinematic atmosphere. The image is shot with a shallow depth of field, drawing attention to the intricate details of the static and the tactile quality of the television, while the rest of the scene fades into a dreamy blur. The mood is contemplative and slightly surreal, reminiscent of vintage films or memory-laden photographs, capturing a quiet moment suspended between eras.
